entities.summary: Major-General Gerald Harry George Lloyd-Verney, was a senior British Army officer who commanded the 7th Armoured Division during the Second World War. He changed his name by Deed poll from Gerald Lloyd Verney to Gerald Lloyd-Verney in 1941.
